package.name: rbl_mission
package.description: Mission layer on top of the unchanged rbl_controller_node: sequences its ~/goto goals into tasks. warehouse_inspection_node flies to a requested aisle position, scans the shelf there with a boustrophedon coverage pattern built from a prior map, then returns to where it started. ugv_uav_mission_node: a UGV carries the UAV to the aisle, the UAV takes off from it and inspects the shelf while the UGV moves on to the next aisle (srv/Deploy). mission_viz_node: a simplified rviz picture of the two vehicles and the warehouse.
